actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

official_title: To amend the Federal Power Act to provide that activities to maintain or increase the capacity of the electric grid within certain areas are a category of actions designated as being categorically excluded from the preparation of an environmental assessment or an environmental impact statement under the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, and for other purposes.
